title: Rich text
summary: A form field for formatted text: paragraphs, headings 2 to 4, bold, italic, links, bulleted and numbered lists and quotes, with a toolbar, undo and redo. Its value is HTML of that subset and nothing else: the value it is given, every paste and drop and every edit are cleaned to it.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

size.description: The field ladder, as sf-textarea's: the frame, the padding and the text of the same size; the toolbar's buttons a rung below.

appearance.description: How the field looks: a bordered box or a filled one, sf-textarea's two boxes.

label.description: The visible name of the field; it names the editing surface. Without it the host's aria-label does.

required.description: The form is not sent while the value is empty (value-missing).

placeholder.description: Shown while the field holds no text; said as aria-placeholder.

hint.description: The line under the field; it describes the editing surface.

name.description: The form name the value is sent under.

rows.description: The fewest lines the text area shows; it grows with the text.

max-rows.description: The most lines before the text scrolls inside. Unset means no cap; a value below rows is rows.

disabled.description: Not editable, not focusable and not sent with the form; a disabled fieldset does the same.

readonly.description: Read and selected but not changed; the toolbar is disabled, the value is sent.

invalid.description: The page's verdict: the error look and aria-invalid, with error-message under the field.

error-message.description: Shown in place of the hint while invalid.

value.description: HTML of the subset p, h2, h3, h4, strong, em, a[href], ul, ol, li, blockquote, br; href only https:, mailto:, tel: or a /path on the site. Cleaned when it is given and as it is edited; "" when there is no text.

html_subset.const: p h2 h3 h4 strong em a[href] ul ol li blockquote br

runCommand.summary: Runs a toolbar command on the current selection: paragraph, heading-2, heading-3, heading-4, bold, italic, link (opens the link editor), bulleted-list, numbered-list, quote, undo, redo. The result is cleaned, recorded for undo and said with input. Returns whether it ran (false while disabled or read-only).

undo.summary: Steps back one cleaned state and says input; false when there is nothing to undo.

redo.summary: Steps forward one cleaned state and says input; false when there is nothing to redo.

input.summary: The text changed while it is edited: typing, a paste or a drop, a toolbar command, undo or redo; once per change, after the value is cleaned. The native event bubbles from the editing surface, which is its target.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

change.summary: The value was committed: the person left the field with a value other than the one it had; a native Event from the editing surface, as a textarea's on leaving it.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: trusting the value without the server's own sanitizer

keyboard: Tab reaches the toolbar (one stop) and then the text; Tab in the text leaves the field
ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End move between the toolbar's buttons
Mod+B and Mod+I toggle bold and italic, Mod+K opens the link editor
Mod+Z undoes, Mod+Shift+Z and Mod+Y redo
Enter in the link editor applies, Escape closes it
accessibility.focus: The frame draws the focus ring while the text has keyboard focus; a click into the text draws none. Toolbar commands keep the caret and the selection in the text; the link editor takes focus when it opens and gives the caret back to the text when it closes.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-rich-text for formatted text a person writes in a form -- a page's text, a description, an announcement -- stored as the HTML subset of Larena's html@1 type.
do_not: Do not trust the submitted value on the server: clean it there with the same subset
Do not use it for one line of text or for code; use sf-input, sf-textarea or sf-code-input
Do not put the value into a page with innerHTML without a sanitizer: render it through the server's cleaned copy or SF.sanitizeHtml
Do not add tags or attributes to the subset in a product; ask for a change of the html@1 type
